newsitem.title: USA: O&R net drops on natgas marketing loss.
newsitem.headline: O&R net drops on natgas marketing loss.

text.p: Orange and Rockland Utilities Inc Friday reported sharply lower first quarter profits saying the majority of the decline resulted from a loss by the utility's natural gas marketing subsidiary.
Net income dropped to $0.46 per share from $1.01.
The company said the natural gas marketing loss of $0.33 per share reflected a write-down of receivables as well as the subsidiary's continued poor operating performance.
It said "the subsidiary's performance is expected to be unfavorable during the balance of the year."

Orange and Rockland said utility earnings experienced a modest first quarter decline of $0.05 per share as below-normal energy sales resulting from the mild winter were partially offset by continued success in containing utility expenses. ((-- Jim Brumm 212-859-1710.))
